instruction: Place an amazon order for 1 quantity of 'Sony PlayStation 5', 1 quantity of 'Etekcity Food Kitchen Scale' and 1 quantity of 'Xbox Series S Console', and have it delivered to my home. Use Discover payment card if it's already in my account, otherwise use what I have in it. Also, I have important things in my cart, so revert its state to as it is now after the order.
notes: Single-app (amazon) task. The pre-existing cart contents are unknown at planning time, so they are abstracted into one product object `original-cart-product` with `original-quantity`; show_cart reveals its id/quantity (known-id), clear_cart (which must come after show_cart and can only happen once) removes it, and after place_order it is re-added with add_product_to_cart (repeated per real cart entry at execution time). Quantities are enforced at add time via the static `target-quantity` relation, so `(in-cart ?p)` / `(order-contains ?o ?p)` implicitly carry the required quantity (1 for each wanted product). place_order orders exactly what is in the cart: its precondition requires the three distinct wanted products in the cart and the original entry out of it, uses the preferred card (Discover if present, else the existing card - selection happens in the show_payment_cards binding) and the home address, and its effect empties the cart. Extra non-API parameters (?p on show_cart/clear_cart, ?o ?p1 ?p2 ?p3 ?po on place_order, and the record parameters on complete_task) exist only to name the records involved; complete_task's precondition restates every goal condition and it is the only action producing (task-completed), which all other actions require to be false.

plan: (amazon-place-order chosen-payment-card home-address amazon-token order-1 etekcity-food-kitchen-scale sony-playstation-5 xbox-series-s-console original-cart-product)
(supervisor-complete-task order-1 chosen-payment-card home-address etekcity-food-kitchen-scale sony-playstation-5 xbox-series-s-console original-cart-product)
